cause_assessment.description: The required GPU-marked tests use the real Codex CLI and its TUI; the captured failure output reported “We're currently experiencing high demand, which may cause temporary errors.”

human_action: A person outside this code change must provide stable real-Codex capacity or decide an operational retry/skip policy for this required external integration gate to prevent repeated long test runs.
impact: The repository-required GPU full test run spent about 18 minutes and ended with four failures before the final TUI case was interrupted; the target test and all non-GPU verification still passed.
summary: GPU integration verification repeatedly failed because the real Codex CLI reported high demand
